sectors.risk_to_thesis: A major hyperscaler announcing a pause or reduction in AI capex — or NVDA missing data center revenue estimates by more than 5% — would break the AI semi narrative and trigger rapid de-rating across the sector.

swing_trade_setup.best_structure: Buy ATM or slightly OTM calls 3-4 weeks out on NVDA pullbacks to the 50MA ($210 area), targeting a retest of all-time highs above $240.
swing_trade_setup.key_levels_to_watch: NVDA support at $210 (50MA), then $195 (prior swing low); resistance at $240 and $250. VIX breaking above 18 would signal a regime shift that hits semis hardest.
swing_trade_setup.avoid: Buying front-month weekly calls on NVDA — the premium in a low-vol environment is rich and theta decay will erode edge quickly. Also avoid shorting the sector into AI capex momentum.

news_signal_vs_noise.signal: Any hyperscaler capex guidance updates (MSFT, GOOGL earnings or conference commentary) and NVDA's next quarterly data center revenue print — these drive the entire sector's direction.
news_signal_vs_noise.noise: Daily speculation about NVDA's next product launch timeline or incremental China export restriction headlines — the market has already priced the known restrictions, and product launches are telegraphed quarters in advance.
